Subject: Stormline Shell is back — limited stock
Preview: 420g, 20k/20k rated. Ready when the forecast isn't.
Body: You checked. It was gone. It's back.

The Northbay Stormline Shell (NB-JKT-07) is restocked, and quantities are limited.

Here's what it does: the 3-layer laminate construction holds up through sustained wet weather — not just a passing shower. The 20,000mm waterproof rating keeps water out under real pressure. The 20,000 g/m² breathability rating means moisture moves out while you're moving hard. It weighs 420g, so it earns its place in the pack without negotiation.

What it's not built for: extreme alpine cold or high-output insulation. This is a shell — layer it accordingly.

If you've been waiting, now's the time.
